FIRST AMENDMENT TO ZONINGLOT DEVELOPMENTAND EASEMENT AGREEMENT certain Zoning Lot Development and Easement Agreement dated as of November 15, 2017 (the “Agreement"), and is made by AMERICAN BROADCASTING COMPANIES, INC.("Owner"), a Delaware corporation, having an address at c/o The Walt Disney Company, 500 South Buena Vista Street, Burbank, California 91521-0964, Attention: Christine McCarthy and WEST 66TH SPONSOR LLC (*"Developer"), a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at 805 Third Avenue, 7th Floor, New York, New York 10022. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner and Developer entered into the Agreement dated as of November 15, 2017 and recorded on December 1, 2017 in the Office of the City Register of New York at CRFN 2017000441506; WHEREAS, Developer conveyed a portion of Developer Land to Owner by quitclaim deeddated asofthedatehereof; WHEREAS, Owner and Developer desire to amend the Agreement to revise the descriptions of the Owner Land and Developer Land to reflect this conveyance, which did not in any way affect the boundary of the Merged Zoning Lot. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are 1． All capitalized terms used in this Amendment but not otherwise defined in this Amendment shall have the meanings ascribed to such terms in the Agreement. 2.1  The metes and bounds description of Owner Land attached as Exhibit “A" of the Agreement is hereby replaced with the metes and bounds description attached hereto as Schedule A. 3. The metes and bounds description of Developer Land attached as Exhibit “B"of the Agreement is hereby replaced with the metes and bounds description attached hereto as ScheduleB. 4. The metes and bounds description of the Easement Area attached as “Exhibit E" of the Agreement is hereby replaced with the metes and bounds description attached hereto as Schedule C.  5.Except as modified pursuant to this Amendment, the Agreement shall otherwise be infull force and effect. 6. This Amendment may be executed in multiple counterparts but all such counterparts put together shall constitute but one and the same Amendment. 64822577.5
